Rede's first public beta: a native audiobook player for Audiobookshelf, for macOS and Linux. It shares Ond's playback engine and look, with a library and controls built for books.

This is an early beta. Keep your Audiobookshelf backups: Rede writes listening progress, finished status and bookmarks to your server. Please report problems with your OS, Rede and server versions, and steps to reproduce.

### Downloads

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `Rede-0.1.0-beta.1-macos-universal.dmg` (or `.zip`) | macOS 11 or later, Apple silicon and Intel |
| `Rede-0.1.0-beta.1-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | Linux on Intel/AMD, glibc 2.39 or newer |
| `Rede-0.1.0-beta.1-linux-aarch64.tar.gz` | Linux on ARM64, glibc 2.39 or newer |

On macOS, open the dmg and drag Rede to Applications. On Linux, unpack the archive and run `./install.sh`; it installs under `~/.local`. Linux needs PipeWire's library and an unlocked Secret Service keyring (GNOME Keyring or KWallet).

[Install and sign-in instructions](https://github.com/Solidsilver/ond/blob/rede-v0.1.0-beta.1/docs/rede/README.md).

### Listening

- Browse Home, the library, book and series pages; search with ⌘K / Ctrl+K.
- Resume where you left off, jump between chapters and set your skip intervals.
- Change speed without changing pitch; optionally use voice boost and silence removal.
- Set a sleep timer for a duration or the end of a chapter, with a fade and rewind.
- Add bookmarks and pick up progress from another device.
- Download books, listen offline, and sync progress and listening sessions when the server returns.
- See listening history in Stats.
- Full, Player and Mini windows, light and dark themes, interface zoom and keyboard shortcuts.

### Beta limits

- Audiobookshelf 2.26 or newer; 2.36 or newer recommended. One account at a time.
- Linux uses username/password sign-in. Browser/OpenID sign-in, media keys and system now-playing controls are macOS-only for now.
- Output follows the system device. No in-app output picker yet.
- Local folders, podcasts, Windows bundles and a mixed multi-account library come later.
- No automatic update check yet. Later betas will be on this repository's releases page.
